research_question: How do black holes form, and what remains uncertain?

sources.title: What Are Black Holes?
notes: A sufficiently massive stellar core can collapse into a black hole; matter around the event horizon may emit detectable radiation.

sources.title: Types of Black Holes
notes: Stellar-mass, intermediate-mass and supermassive categories are used; mass ranges and the evidence for intermediate objects are still refined.

sources.title: Massive Black Holes and the Evolution of Galaxies
notes: Supermassive black-hole seed formation is uncertain; possible routes include growth from stellar remnants or direct collapse of massive gas clouds.
